d: Alice Huang’s background is coming under scrutiny after the scandal involving Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. According to reports, she was born in rural Hunan, studied media in Hong Kong and worked for CCTV before moving into finance, first at HSBC and then at state-backed CITIC Securities. Her career then took another turn through Hexi Capital and its founder Kang Wei, who was twice fined by Chinese regulators.
